svg.aria-label: General arrangement drawing of the coupled attitude and manipulator testbed. View A elevation: a levelled base plate supports a post containing two 608 bearings, on which a 1U cube rotates about a vertical yaw axis; inside the cube a flat reaction wheel spins about that same axis driven by a brushless motor, with an isolated IMU and electronics, and a three-joint arm on the top face. View B plan: all three arm joints rotate about vertical axes so the arm sweeps horizontally, with two different poses reaching the same hand position. View C: a three-step sequence showing that arm motion swings the base unless the reaction wheel absorbs the momentum.
svg.text: GENERAL ARRANGEMENT · CONCEPT · NOT TO SCALE

g.text: ARM LIES FLAT — SWEEPS IN & OUT OF PAGE
ALL THREE JOINTS ROTATE ABOUT VERTICAL AXES
NOTHING LIFTS — GRAVITY NEVER LOADS A JOINT
Printed disc, steel dowel ballast at rim
608ZZ pair — the only axis that moves
Level, or gravity biases every run
WHY THE WHEEL IS THERE · TOP VIEW SEQUENCE
A elev · B plan · C mech
